questions.text: How often do you use alcohol or other substances?
Do you ever use substances to cope with stress?
Has anyone expressed concern about your substance use?
Do you feel you need substances to have fun?
Have you ever tried to cut down but couldn't?

low.message: Low risk. Keep building healthy habits.

moderate.message: Moderate risk. Consider talking to someone you trust.

high.message: High risk. Please reach out to a professional.

questions.text: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt down or hopeless?
Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had trouble sleeping?
Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt tired?
Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you lost interest in activities?
Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt anxious or worried?

low.message: You seem to be doing well. Keep it up!

moderate.message: Some signs of concern. Consider talking to someone.

high.message: You may need support. Please reach out.

questions.text: How often do friends offer you substances?
Do you feel comfortable saying no to friends?
Have you ever used substances just to fit in?
Do your friends use substances regularly?
Would you lose friends if you refused to use substances?

moderate.message: Some peer pressure vulnerability. Building skills will help.

high.message: High peer pressure risk. Consider expanding your social circle.

questions.text: How would you rate your overall wellbeing this week?
How well are you sleeping?
How connected do you feel to family and friends?
How confident do you feel about the future?
How well are you managing daily stress?

moderate.message: Room for improvement. Small changes can help.

high.message: Your wellbeing needs attention. Please seek support.
